title: Visited positions on embedded tapes
statement: Let $\iota$ embed the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, with distinguished index $\mathrm{cap}$ outside its image, and let $M$ be an $m$-tape machine. For any initial configuration, background tape contents and head positions, prefix, initial output, natural number $t$, and tape index $i<m$, the set of head positions visited through time $t$ on tape $\iota(i)$ by the silent embedding equals the set visited on tape $i$ by $M$. Consequently, the numbers of distinct positions in these two sets are equal.
